independent_raw_audit.method: SHA256 and byte size of every measured request and response; compare raw timing/counts to records; validate frozen max256/cachefalse/temp0/seed1234; compare exact token IDs/content/stop_type/stopping_word/truncated for all arms within each repetition/prompt.
independent_raw_audit.timing: Audit wall not prospectively recorded; no aggregate preparation-clock claim.

findings.finding: The measured remaining gap is predominantly inside the server generation interval, which includes drafter, target verification, feature catch-up/cache and scheduling; not pure verifier GPU time.
findings.evidence: 93.91% of selected-minus-DFlash request wall difference falls in server_generation_seconds on this one natural cohort.
findings.implication: Prioritize acceptance and current decode component measurement; HTTP/prompt-only optimization cannot explain the main gap.

findings.finding: Acceptance improved with training but remains substantially below paired DFlash.
findings.implication: Both fewer verifier rounds from better drafts and lower per-round overhead are plausible. Acceptance alone is not throughput; these are aggregate proposed/accepted counters, not exact emitted-draft counts.

findings.finding: Current native EAGLE process() runs encoder and decoder on full verify batch, including rejected proposal rows, before rollback.
findings.evidence: common/speculative.cpp:505–510,654–799; target server-context.cpp:4752; catch-up decoder uses all output=false.
findings.implication: A concrete current implementation waste hypothesis. Feature-capture/cache/deferred-boundary semantics must be retained; no skip implementation or speed promise is authorized by this source audit.

existing_timer_capabilities.name: Cumulative speculative begin/generate/accept host timers
existing_timer_capabilities.access: Run unchanged server at -lv4; parse per-request statistics draft-eagle3: #calls(b,g,a) and dur(b,g,a) deltas.
existing_timer_capabilities.limits: process(batch) is untimed; no explicit pre/post synchronization contract for all work; host timings may charge prior async work to later waits; generation timer omits target feature/catch-up costs outside draft(). Cannot subtract from a separately measured clean run.

existing_timer_capabilities.name: Exact target verification rounds
existing_timer_capabilities.access: GET /metrics before and after each completed measured request, outside the request timer; subtract llamacpp:spec_decode_num_drafts_total. Also subtract accepted/proposed counters and crosscheck response. Per-position accepted counters are also available as llamacpp:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_per_pos_total{position="0"}, etc (server-task.cpp:1651–1657).
existing_timer_capabilities.limits: Round count includes native verification behavior/replays as defined by stats. Do not infer emitted accepted drafts from accepted count; end-of-budget truncation can differ.

existing_timer_capabilities.name: Current trace interposer
existing_timer_capabilities.access: modern_trace.cpp / libw1a8-modern-trace.so from existing trace-build receipt
existing_timer_capabilities.limits: Synchronizes and writes/fsyncs tensors. Its manifest explicitly invalidates performance timings; useful for semantics/counts, not clean component or throughput claims.
